title: Crispy Fritters with Kissed Oats
description: A sweet and crispy treat made with kissed oats and crispy ingredients, perfect for a snack.

ingredients.name: Kissed Oats
ingredients.notes: Toasted oats with a hint of sweetness

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.notes: To balance the sweetness of the oats

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the kissed oats, crispy fritter mix, sugar, and eggs.
Mix well until a sticky dough forms.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the dough onto a baking sheet.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
